Arise O children of the light,

section.en: The Hymn of Ten-theno, Ⲡⲓⲃⲱϩⲉⲙ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲧⲉⲛⲑⲏⲛⲟⲩ

text.en: let us praise the Lord of hosts.

text.cop: + Ϩⲟⲡⲱⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲉⲣϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲥⲱϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲯⲩⲭⲏ.
text.cop_lat: + Hopos enteferehmot nan emepsoti ente nenpsishee.
text.en: + That He may grant us the salvation of our souls.
Whenever we stand before You in the flesh.

text.cop: + Ⲁ̀ⲗⲓⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩⲥ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓϩⲩⲛⲓⲙ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲉⲃϣⲓ.
text.cop_lat: + Alioui evol hiten pennous empihinim ente tievshi.
text.en: + Cast away from our minds the slumber of sleep.

text.cop: ϩⲟⲡⲱⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲛⲕⲁϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲛⲟ̀ϩⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲁⲧⲉⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲕⲙ̀ⲑⲟ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲛⲁⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲉⲩⲭⲏ.
text.cop_lat: hopos entenkati entenohi eraten empekemtho emefnav ente ti-eprosevshee.
text.en: that we may know how to stand before You at times of prayer.
text.ar: لكي نفهم أن نقف أمامك وقت الصلاة.

text.cop: + Ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱⲣⲡ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ ⲛ̀ϯⲇⲟⲝⲟⲗⲟⲅⲓⲁ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉⲣⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲡⲓ:
text.cop_lat: + O-woh entenoworp nak e-epshoi entithoksologia etereprepi:
text.en: + And ascribe unto You the befitting glorification,
text.ar: + ونرسل لك إلى فوق التمجيد اللائق،

text.cop: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲛϣⲁϣⲛⲓ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲉⲧⲟϣ.
text.cop_lat: o-woh entenshashni e-epko evol ente nennovi etosh.
text.en: and win the forgiveness of our many sins.
Glory be to You O Lover of Mankind.

text.cop: Ϩⲏⲡⲡⲉ ⲇⲉ ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲃⲓⲁⲓⲕ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ.
text.cop_lat: Heeppe the esmou e-epshois ni-eviaik ente Epshois.
text.en: Behold bless the Lord all you servants of the Lord.
text.ar: ها باركوا الرب يا عبيد الرب.

text.en: Glory be to You O Lover of Mankind.
+ You who stand in the house of the Lord,
in the courts of the house of our God.
Glory be to You O Lover of Mankind.

text.cop: Ⲛ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ϫⲱⲣϩ ϥⲁⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉⲧⲉⲛϫⲓϫ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ.
text.cop_lat: Enehree khen ni-egorh fai ennetenjig e-epshoi nee-ethowab esmou e-epshois.
text.en: By night lift up your hands O you saints and bless the Lord.
text.ar: بالليالي إرفعوا أيديكم إلى فوق أيها القديسون باركوا الرب.

text.en: Glory be to You O Lover of Mankind.

text.cop: + Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲉϥⲉ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲕ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ Ⲥⲓⲱⲛ:
text.cop_lat: + Epshois efe-esmou erok evol khen Sion:
text.en: + The Lord bless you from Zion,
Glory be to You O Lover of Mankind.
Let my cry come before You O Lord,
give me understanding according to Your word.
Glory be to You O Lover of Mankind.
+ Let my supplication come before You,
deliver me according to Your word.
Glory be to You O Lover of Mankind.
My lips shall overflow with praise,
when You have taught me Your statutes.
Glory be to You O Lover of Mankind.

text.cop: + Ⲡⲁⲗⲁⲥ ⲉϥⲉ̀ⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱ̀ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲕⲥⲁϫⲓ ϫⲉ ⲛⲉⲕⲉⲛⲧⲟⲗⲏ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ϩⲁⲛⲙⲉⲑⲙⲏⲓ ⲛⲉ.
text.cop_lat: + Palas efe-erowo khen neksaji je nekentolee teerou hanmethmee ne.
text.en: + My tongue shall speak of Your words for all Your commandments are righteous.
text.ar: + لساني يجيب بأقوالك لأن جميع وصاياك هي حق.

text.en: Glory be to You O Lover of Mankind.

text.cop: Ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲥϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲧⲉⲕϫⲓϫ ⲉ̀ⲫ̀ⲛⲁϩⲙⲉⲧ ϫⲉ ⲛⲉⲕⲉⲛⲧⲟⲗⲏ ⲁⲓⲉⲣⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲑⲩⲙⲓⲛ ⲉ̀ⲣⲱⲟⲩ.
text.cop_lat: Maresshopi enje tekjig e-efnahmet je nekentolee aierepithimin eroou.
text.en: Let Your hand help me for I have chosen Your precepts.
text.ar: لتكن يدك لتخلصني لأني إشتهيت وصاياك.

text.en: Glory be to You O Lover of Mankind.
+ I have longed for Your salvation O Lord,
and Your Law is my delight.
Glory be to You O Lover of Mankind.

text.cop: Ⲉⲥⲉ̀ⲱⲛϧ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲧⲁⲯⲩⲭⲏ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲥⲉ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲕ:
text.cop_lat: Eseonkh enje tapsishee o-woh ese-esmou erok:
text.en: Let my soul live and it shall praise You,
and let Your judgments help me.
Glory be to You O Lover of Mankind.
+ I have gone astray like a lost sheep,

text.cop: ⲕⲱϯ ⲛ̀ⲥⲁ ⲡⲉⲕⲃⲱⲕ ϫⲉ ⲛⲉⲕⲉⲛⲧⲟⲗⲏ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲉⲣⲡⲟⲩⲱⲃϣ.
text.cop_lat: koti ensa pekvok je nekentolee empierpowovsh.
text.en: seek Your servant for I do not forget Your commandments.
text.ar: فأُطلب عبدك لأني لوصاياك لم أنس.

text.en: Glory be to You O Lover of Mankind.

text.cop: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ Ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓ ⲕⲉ Ⲩ̀ⲓⲱ ⲕⲉ Ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲱ Ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ.
text.cop_lat: Thoksa Patri ke I-io ke Agio Epnevmati.
text.en: Glory be to the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit.
Glory be to You O Lover of Mankind.

text.cop: + Ⲕⲉ ⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲁⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲱⲛ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
text.cop_lat: + Ke nin ke a-i ke is tous e-onas ton e-onon ameen.
text.en: + Now and forever and unto the age of all ages Amen.
text.ar: + الآن وكل أوان وإلى دهر الدهور آمين.

text.en: Glory be to You O Lover of Mankind.

text.cop: Ⲡⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲙ̀Ⲫ̀ⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ:
text.cop_lat: Pi-oou emefiot nem Epsheeri nem Pi-epnevma ethowab:
text.en: Glory be to the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit,
text.ar: المجد للآب والإبن والروح القدس منذ الآن

text.cop: ⲓⲥϫⲉⲛ ϯⲛⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
text.cop_lat: isjen tinou nem sha eneh ente ni-eneh teerou ameen.
text.en: now and forever and unto all the ages Amen.
Glory be to You O Lover of Mankind.
+ Glory be to You O good One the Lover of Mankind,
text.ar: + المجد لك يا محب البشر الصالح،

text.cop: ⲡⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲛ̀Ⲧⲉⲕⲙⲁⲩ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁⲕ.
text.cop_lat: pi-oou entekmav emparthenos nem nee-ethowab teerou entak.
text.en: glory be to Your Mother the Virgin and all Your saints.
Glory be to You O Lover of Mankind.
Glory be to You O only-begotten One,
O holy Trinity have mercy upon us.
Glory be to You O Lover of Mankind.

text.cop: + Ⲙⲁⲣⲉϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲙⲁⲣⲟⲩϫⲱⲣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲉϥϫⲁϫⲓ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲙⲁⲣⲟⲩⲫⲱⲧ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲁⲧ̀ϩⲏ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉϥϩⲟ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲉⲑⲙⲟⲥϯ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉϥⲣⲁⲛ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ.
text.cop_lat: + Mareftonf enje Efnoti marougor evol enje nefgaji teerou maroufot evol kha-ethee empefho enje o-on niven ethmosti empefran ethowab.
text.en: + Let God arise and let all His enemies be scattered and let all that hate His holy name flee from before His face.
text.ar: + ليقم الله ولتتبدَّد جميع أعدائه وليهرب من قدام وجهه كل مُبغضي إسمه القدوس.

text.en: Glory be to You O Lover of Mankind.
As for Your people let them be blessed,
a thousand thousand fold and ten thousand ten thousand fold,
and my mouth shall declare Your praise.

text.cop: Ⲧⲟⲧⲉ ⲁϥϩⲱⲥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲙⲱⲩ̀ⲥⲏⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲛϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲓⲥⲣⲁⲏⲗ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲓϩⲱⲇⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϫⲟⲥ ⲉⲑⲣⲟⲩϫⲟⲥ:
text.cop_lat: Tote afhos enje Mo-isees nem nensheeri empisraeel etaihothee ente Epshois o-woh afgos ethrougos:
text.en: Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to the Lord and spoke saying,
text.ar: حينئذ سبح موسى وبنو إسرائيل بهذه التسبحة للرب وقالوا،

section.en: The First Hoos, Ⲡⲓϩⲱⲥ ⲛ̀Ϩⲟⲩⲓⲧ

text.cop: ϫⲉ ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲛϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ϫⲉ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲁϥϭⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩ.
text.cop_lat: je marenhos e-epshois je khen o-oou ghar afchi-oou.
text.en: "I will sing to the Lord for He has triumphed gloriously."
+ The horse and its rider He has thrown into the sea.
The Lord is my strength and song,
and He has become my salvation.
He is my God and I will glorify Him,
my father´s God and I will exalt Him.
+ The Lord is a Man of war,

text.cop: Ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲣⲉϭⲱⲟⲩⲧⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲫⲁⲣⲁⲱ̀ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲧⲉϥϫⲟⲙ ⲧⲏⲣⲥ ⲁϥⲃⲉⲣⲃⲱⲣⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲫ̀ⲓⲟⲙ.
text.cop_lat: Niverechoouts ente fara-o nem tefgom teers afvervorou e-efiom.
text.en: Pharaoh's chariots and his army He has cast into the sea.
text.ar: مركبات فرعون وكل قوته طرحهما في البحر.

text.cop: Ϩⲁⲛⲥⲱⲧⲡ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲃⲁⲧⲏⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲧⲁⲧⲏⲥ ⲁϥϫⲟⲗⲕⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛ ⲫ̀ⲓⲟⲙ ⲛ̀ϣⲁⲣⲓ.
text.cop_lat: Hansotp enanavatees enetristatees afgolkou khen efiom enshari.
text.en: His chosen captains also are drowned in the Red Sea.
text.ar: ركباناً منتخبين ذي ثلاث جنبات غرقهم في البحر الأحمر.

text.en: they sank to the bottom as a stone.
Your right hand O Lord has become glorious in power.
Your right hand O Lord has dashed the enemy in pieces.
text.ar: يدك اليمنى يا إلهي أهلكت أعداءك.

text.en: + And in the greatness of Your excellence,
You have overthrown those who rose up against You,

text.cop: Ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉⲕⲙ̀ⲃⲟⲛ ⲁϥⲟ̀ϩⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲁⲧϥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡⲓⲙⲱⲟⲩ:
text.cop_lat: Evol hiten pi-epnevma ente pekemvon afohi eratf enje pimoou:
text.en: And with the blast of Your nostrils the waters were gathered together,
the flood stood upright like a wall,

text.cop: ⲁⲩϭⲱⲥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲓϫⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲑ̀ⲙⲏϯ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲓⲟⲙ.
text.cop_lat: avchos enje nigol khen ethmeeti emefiom.
text.en: and the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea.
my lust shall be satisfied upon them,

text.cop: ⲛ̀ⲧⲁϧⲱⲧⲉⲃ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲁⲥⲏϥⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲁϫⲓϫ ⲉⲣϭⲟⲓⲥ.
text.cop_lat: entakhoteb khen taseefi ente tajig ershois.
text.en: I will draw my sword and my hand shall destroy them."

text.cop: ⲁⲩⲱⲙⲥ ⲉ̀ⲡⲉⲥⲏⲧ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲧⲁⲧϩ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲩⲟϣ.
text.cop_lat: avoms epeseet emefreeti enoutath khen hanmoou evosh.
text.en: they sank like lead in the mighty waters.
text.ar: وغطسوا إلى أسفل كالرصاص في مياه كثيرة.

text.cop: + Ⲛⲓⲙ ⲉⲧⲟ̀ⲛⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲕ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲛⲟⲩϯ Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ.
text.cop_lat: + Nim etoni emmok khen ninoti Epshois.
text.en: + Who is like You O Lord among the gods?

text.cop: Ⲁⲕⲥⲟⲩⲧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲕⲟⲩⲓ̀ⲛⲁⲙ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲁϥⲟⲙⲕⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ.
text.cop_lat: Aksouten tekouinam evol afomkou enje epkahi.
text.en: You stretched out Your right hand, the earth swallowed them.

text.cop: Ⲁⲕϭⲓⲙⲱⲓⲧ ϧⲁϫⲱϥ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲕⲗⲁⲟⲥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲙⲉⲑⲙⲏⲓ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲕⲥⲟⲧⲡϥ:
text.cop_lat: Akchimoit khagof empeklaos khen oumethmee fai etaksotpf:
text.en: You in Your mercy have led forth the people whom You have redeemed,
text.ar: هديت شعبك بالحقيقة، هذا الذي إخترته،

text.en: You have guided them in Your strength,
+ The people will hear and be afraid,
sorrow will take hold of the inhabitants of Palestine.

text.cop: Ⲧⲟⲧⲉ ⲁⲩⲓⲏⲥ ⲙ̀ⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲓϩⲏⲅⲉⲙⲱⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲉ̀ⲇⲱⲙ:
text.cop_lat: Tote aviees emmoou enje niheegemon ente Ethom:
text.en: Then the dukes of Edom will be amazed,

text.cop: ⲛⲓⲁⲣⲭⲱⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲛⲓⲙⲱⲁ̀ⲃⲓⲧⲏⲥ ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲑⲉⲣⲧⲉⲣ ⲡⲉ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥϭⲓⲧⲟⲩ.
text.cop_lat: niarkhon ente Nimo-avitees ou-esterter pe etafchitou.
text.en: the mighty men of Moab trembling will take hold of them.

text.cop: + Ⲁⲩⲃⲱⲗ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲉⲧϣⲟⲡ ϧⲉⲛ Ⲭⲁⲛⲁⲁⲛ:
text.cop_lat: + Avvol evol enje o-on niven etshop khen Khana-an:
text.en: + All the inhabitants of Canaan will melt away,

text.cop: ⲁϥⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲑⲉⲣⲧⲉⲣ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩϩⲟϯ.
text.cop_lat: afi e-ehree egoou enje ou-esterter nem ouhoti.
text.en: fear and dread will fall on them.
By the greatness of Your arm they will be as still as stone,
till Your people pass over O Lord,
till Your people pass over whom You have purchased.
text.ar: حتى يجتاز شعبك هذا الذي إقتنيته.

text.cop: + Ⲁ̀ⲛⲓⲧⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲧⲟϫⲟⲩ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉⲕⲕ̀ⲗⲏⲣⲟⲛⲟⲙⲓⲁ:
text.cop_lat: + Anitou ekhoun togou hijen outoou ente tekekleeronomia:
text.en: + You will bring them in and plant them in the mountain of Your inheritance,
which You have made for You to dwell in.

text.cop: Ⲡⲉⲕⲙⲁ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲩⲥⲉⲃⲧⲱⲧϥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲉⲕϫⲓϫ:
text.cop_lat: Pekma ethowab Epshois fee-etavsevtotf enje nekjig:
text.en: In Your sanctuary O Lord which Your hands have established,
text.ar: موضعك المقدس يا رب الذي أعددته يداك،

text.cop: Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲉⲕⲟⲓ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲓⲥϫⲉⲛ ⲡ̀ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉ̀ⲧⲓ.
text.cop_lat: Epshois ekoi enouro sha eneh nem isjen epeneh o-woh eti.
text.en: the Lord shall reign forever and ever.
text.ar: يا رب تمَلُك منذ الأزل والآن وإلى الأبد.

text.cop: + Ϫⲉ ⲁⲩⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀ⲫ̀ⲓⲟⲙ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲓϩ̀ⲑⲱⲣ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲫⲁⲣⲁⲱ̀ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲉϥⲃⲉⲣⲉϭⲱⲟⲩⲧⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲉϥϭⲁⲥⲓϩ̀ⲑⲟ.
text.cop_lat: + Je avi ekhoun e-efiom enje ni-ehthor ente fara-o nem nefverechoouts nem nefchasi-ehtho.
text.en: + For the horses of pharaoh went with his chariots and his horsemen into the sea.
text.ar: + لأنه قد دخل إلى البحر خيل فرعون ومركباته وفرسانه.

text.cop: Ⲁ̀ Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲫ̀ⲓⲟⲙ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲟⲩ:
text.cop_lat: A Epshois en pimoou ente efiom e-ehree egoou:
text.en: And the Lord brought back the waters of the sea upon them,

text.cop: ⲛⲉⲛϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲇⲉ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲓⲥⲣⲁⲏⲗ ⲛⲁⲩⲙⲟϣⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲧϣⲟⲩⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛ ⲑ̀ⲙⲏϯ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲓⲟⲙ.
text.cop_lat: nensheeri the empisraeel navmoshi khen petshowoou khen ethmeeti emefiom.
text.en: but the children of Israel went on dry land in the midst of the sea.
text.ar: أما بنو إسرائيل فكانوا يمشون على اليابسة في وسط البحر.

text.cop: + Ⲁⲥϭⲓ ⲇⲉ ⲛⲁⲥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁⲙ ϯⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲏⲥ:
text.cop_lat: + Aschi the nas enje Mariam ti-eprofeetees:

text.en: took a timbrel in her hand,

text.cop: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲥⲁⲙⲉⲛϩⲏⲥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲓϩⲓⲟⲙⲓ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲉⲙⲕⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲙ ϩⲁⲛϩⲱⲥ.
text.cop_lat: o-woh avi evol samenhees enje nihiomi teerou khen hankemkem nem hanhos.
text.en: and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with praises.
text.ar: وخرج في إثرها جميع النسوة بالدُفوف والتسابيح.

text.cop: Ⲁⲥⲉⲣϩⲏⲧⲥ ⲇⲉ ϧⲁϫⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁⲙ ⲉⲥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ:
text.cop_lat: Aserheets the khagoou enje Mariam esgo emmos:

text.en: He has thrown into the sea.

text.cop: + Ⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲙ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲭ̀ⲣⲏⲥⲧⲟⲥ ⲟⲩⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ ⲡⲉ:

section.en: The Hymn of the Resurrection - Tennav, Ⲡⲓⲃⲱϩⲉⲙ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ϯⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥⲓⲥ - Ⲧⲉⲛⲛⲁⲩ

text.en: We bow down to Your Cross O Christ,
and we praise and glorify Your Resurrection.

text.cop: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲛⲥⲱⲟⲩⲛ ⲛ̀ⲕⲉⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲏⲗ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲕ:
text.cop_lat: o-woh entensooun enkeowai an eveel erok:
text.en: and we know none but You,
and after Your name we are called.

text.cop: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ Ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓ ⲕⲉ Ⲩ̀ⲓⲱ ⲕⲉ Ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲱ Ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ.
text.cop_lat: Thoksa Patri ke I-io ke Agio Epnevmati.
text.en: Glory be to the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit.

text.cop: + Ⲁ̀ⲙⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲛⲓⲡⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ ⲛ̀Ⲧ̀ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥⲓⲥ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲓⲭ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ.
text.cop_lat: + Amoini teerou nipistos entenowosht enetanastasis empi-ekhristos.
text.en: + Come all you believers let us bow down to the Resurrection of Christ.
text.ar: + تعالوا يا جميع المؤمنين لنسجد لقيامة المسيح.

text.cop: ⲁϥⲓ̀ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲫ̀ⲣⲁϣⲓ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣϥ.
text.cop_lat: afi enje efrashi ekhoun epikosmos teerf.
text.en: joy has entered into the whole world.
Let us bless the Lord continually,

text.cop: Ϫⲉ ⲁϥⲉⲣϩⲩⲡⲟⲙⲟⲛⲓⲛ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϧⲟⲙϧⲉⲙ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ Ⲡⲉϥⲙⲟⲩ.
text.cop_lat: Je aferhipomonin o-woh afkhomkhem emefmou hiten Pefmou.
text.en: For He was patient and destroyed death by His Death.

text.cop: Ⲕⲉ ⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲁⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲱⲛ:
text.cop_lat: Ke nin ke a-i ke is tous e-onas ton e-onon:
text.en: Now and forever and unto the age of all ages,
text.ar: الآن وكل أوان وإلى دهر الدهور،

text.cop: + Ⲛⲓⲣⲁϣⲓ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲥⲉⲧⲱⲙⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟ ⲱ̀ Ϯⲑⲉⲟ̀ⲧⲟⲕⲟⲥ.
text.cop_lat: + Nirashi teerou setomi ero o Tithe-otokos.
text.en: + All joy befits you O Theotokos.

text.cop: Ϫⲉ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲧⲟϯ ⲁⲩⲧⲁⲥⲑⲟ ⲛ̀Ⲁ̀ⲇⲁⲙ ⲉ̀Ⲡⲓⲡⲁⲣⲁⲇⲓⲥⲟⲥ.
text.cop_lat: Je evol hitoti avtasto enadam epiparathisos.
text.en: For through you Adam returned to Paradise.

text.cop: Ⲉ̀ⲁⲥϭⲓ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲥⲟⲗⲥⲉⲗ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲉ̀ⲩⲁ ⲉ̀ⲫ̀ⲙⲁ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲥⲙ̀ⲕⲁϩⲛ̀ϩⲏⲧ.
text.cop_lat: Easchi enousolsel enje Eva e-efma empesemkahenheet.
text.en: And Eve gained grace to replace her sadness.
text.ar: لأنه من قِبَلِك أُرجع آدم إلى الفردوس.

text.en: Through you she gained freedom once more,

text.ar: وأخذت الحرية دفعة أخرى من أجلك،

text.en: And we too let us glorify you,
as a treasure of the Resurrection.

text.cop: Ϫⲉ ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲑⲩⲥⲁⲩⲣⲟⲥ ⲉⲧⲧⲟⲃ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲛⲉⲣⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲗⲉⲩⲓⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲱⲛϧ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲧⲟⲧϥ.
text.cop_lat: Je shere pithisavros ettob etanerapolevin empionkh evol hitotf.
text.en: "Hail to the sealed treasure through which we were given life.
text.ar: "السلام للكنز المختوم الذي إمتلأنا بالحياة من قِبَله.

text.en: Hail to her who gave birth to Christ our God,
text.ar: السلام للتي ولدت لنا المسيح إلهنا،

text.cop: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϯ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲱⲛϧ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ Ⲧⲉϥⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥⲓⲥ.
text.cop_lat: o-woh afti nan empionkh evol hiten Tefanastasis.
text.ar: وأعطانا الحياة من قِبَل قيامته." مبارك أنت

text.en: through His Resurrection." Blessed are You O Lord,

text.cop: + Ⲛⲓⲥ̀ⲧ̀ⲣⲁⲧⲓⲁ ⲛ̀ⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲓⲕⲟⲛ ⲁⲩⲧⲱⲙⲧ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡ̀ϫⲓⲛⲑ̀ⲣⲟⲩⲛⲁⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲕ ⲉ̀ⲁⲩⲟⲡⲕ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲣⲉϥⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ.

text.en: + The angelic hosts were amazed when they saw You counted among the dead.
text.ar: + الجنود الملائكية بهتوا عندما رأوك حُسبت مع الأموات.

text.cop: Ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲕϧⲟⲙϧⲉⲙ ⲛ̀ϯϫⲟⲙ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲫ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲱ̀ Ⲡⲓⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣ.
text.cop_lat: O-woh akkhomkhem entigom ente efmou o Pisoteer.
text.en: Yet You destroyed the power of death O Savior.

text.cop: Ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲕⲧⲟⲩⲛⲟⲥ Ⲁ̀ⲇⲁⲙ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲕ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲕⲁⲓϥ ⲛ̀ⲣⲉⲙϩⲉ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ Ⲁ̀ⲙⲉⲛϯ.
text.cop_lat: O-woh aktounos Adam nemak o-woh akaif enremhe evol khen Amenti.
text.en: You raised Adam with You and freed him from Hades.
text.ar: وأقمت آدم معك وأعتقته من الجحيم.

text.cop: + Ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲟⲩ ⲛⲓⲥⲟϫⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲛⲉϩⲡⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲣⲓⲙⲓ ⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲑⲱⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲟⲩⲉ̀ⲣⲏⲟⲩ:
text.cop_lat: + Ethve ou nisojen nem ninehpi nem nirimi tetenthot emmoou nem nowereeou:

text.ar: + لماذا الطيب والنحيب والبكاء تمزجنها مع بعضها

text.cop: Ⲡⲉϫⲉ ⲡⲓⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲉⲧϩⲓⲉⲃⲣⲏϫ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲁⲧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲙ̀ϩⲁⲩ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓϩⲓⲟⲙⲓ ⲙ̀ϥⲁⲓⲥⲟϫⲉⲛ:

text.cop: ϫⲉ ⲁϥⲟ̀ϩⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲁⲧϥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲡⲓⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ.
text.cop_lat: je afohi eratf enje Pisoteer o-woh aftonf evol khen nee-ethmoout.
text.en: that the Savior has risen from the dead." Blessed
text.ar: وأعلمنَّ أنه قد نهض المخلص وقام من الأموات." مبارك أنت

text.en: + The women rushed very early to Your tomb,
text.ar: + أسرعت النسوة باكراً جداً إلى قبرك،

text.cop: Ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲁϥⲟ̀ϩⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲁⲧϥ ϩⲓϫⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡⲓⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ:

text.en: but preach the Resurrection to the Apostles."
text.ar: بل بشرنَّ بالقيامة للرسل." مبارك أنت

text.cop: + Ⲛⲓϩⲓⲟⲙⲓ ⲙ̀ϥⲁⲓⲥⲟϫⲉⲛ ⲁⲩⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ⲡⲉⲕⲙ̀ϩⲁⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲥ̀ⲑⲟⲓⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ ⲱ̀ Ⲡⲓⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣ.
text.cop_lat: + Nihiomi emfaisojen avi epekemhav nem pi-estoinoufi o Pisoteer.

text.ar: + أتينَّ النسوة حاملات الطيب إلى قبرك مع البخور أيها المخلص.

text.cop: Ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ:
text.cop_lat: O-woh avsotem epiangelos efgo emmos noou:
text.en: They heard the angel say to them,

text.cop: ϫⲉ ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲟⲩ ⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲕⲱϯ ⲛ̀ⲥⲁ ⲫⲏⲉⲧⲟⲛϧ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲣⲉϥⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ.
text.cop_lat: je ethve ou tetenkoti ensa fee-etonkh nem nirefmoout.
text.en: "Why do you seek the living among the dead."

text.cop: Ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟϥ ϩⲱⲥ Ⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲙ̀ϩⲁⲩ.
text.cop_lat: O-woh enthof hos Noti aftonf evol khen pi-emhav.
text.en: And He being God has risen from the tomb.

text.cop: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ Ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓ ⲕⲉ Ⲩ̀ⲓⲱ ⲕⲉ Ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲱ Ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ.
text.cop_lat: Thoksa Patri ke I-io ke Agio Epnevmati.
text.en: Glory be to the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit.

text.cop: + Ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ ⲙ̀Ⲫ̀ⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ:
text.cop_lat: + Tenowosht emefiot nem Epsheeri nem Pi-epnevma ethowab:
text.en: + We worship the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit,
And we proclaim with the Cherubim saying,

text.cop: ϫⲉ ⲭ̀ⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲭ̀ⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲭ̀ⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟⲕ Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ.
text.cop_lat: je ekowab ekowab ekowab enthok Epshois.

text.cop: Ⲕⲉ ⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲁⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲱⲛ:
text.cop_lat: Ke nin ke a-i ke is tous e-onas ton e-onon:
text.en: holy are You O Lord." Now and forever and unto the age of all ages,
text.ar: أنت يا رب." الآن وكل أوان وإلى دهر الدهور،

text.en: + You gave birth O Virgin to the Giver of life,

text.cop: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁ̀ⲣⲉⲛⲟϩⲉⲙ ⲛ̀Ⲁ̀ⲇⲁⲙ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
text.cop_lat: o-woh arenohem enadam evol khen efnovi.
text.en: and you saved Adam from sin.
You gave joy to Eve instead of sorrow,

text.cop: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁ̀ⲣⲉⲉⲣϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲱⲛϧ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲫ̀ⲛⲟϩⲉⲙ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡ̀ⲧⲁⲕⲟ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡ̀ϣⲓⲃϯ.
text.cop_lat: o-woh are-erehmot nan emeponkh nem efnohem evol khen eptako nem epshivti.
text.en: and gave us life and salvation from corruption and alteration.
text.ar: وأنعمتِ لنا بالحياة والخلاص من الفساد والتغير.

text.cop: Ⲁ̀ⲣⲉϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲧⲁⲧⲏⲥ ⲛⲁϩⲣⲉⲛ Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ Ⲡⲉⲛⲣⲉϥⲥⲱϯ:
text.cop_lat: Areshopi nan enou-eprostatees nahren Efnoti Penrefsoti:
text.en: You became our intercessor before God our Savior,
text.ar: صرتِ لنا شفيعة أمام الله مخلصنا،

section.en: The Second Hoos Lobsh, Ⲡⲓⲗⲱⲃϣ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲓϩⲱⲥ ⲙ̀Ⲙⲁϩⲥ̀ⲛⲁⲩ

text.en: For He has made the heavens,
+ He caused the rain to fall,
upon the face of the earth,
and gave it to His people,
of the Mother of God Saint Mary,
for You have (risen/come) and saved us.

text.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ Ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲛⲓⲁⲥ Ⲁ̀ⲍⲁⲣⲓⲁⲥ Ⲙⲓⲥⲁⲏⲗ ⲕⲉ Ⲇⲁⲛⲓⲏⲗ:
text.cop_lat: Esmou e-epshois Ananias Azarias Misaeel ke Danieel:
text.en: Bless the Lord O Hananiah Azariah Mishael and Daniel,
text.ar: باركوا الرب يا حنانيا وعزاريا وميصائيل ودانيال،

section.en: The Third Hoos - Esmo Epchois, Ⲡⲓϩⲱⲥ ⲙ̀Ⲙⲁϩϣⲟⲙⲧ - Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ

text.cop: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ ϣⲁ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
text.cop_lat: hos erof arihowo chasf sha ni-eneh.
text.en: praise Him and exalt Him above all forever.

text.cop: + Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲛⲏⲉⲧⲉⲣⲥⲉⲃⲉⲥⲑⲉ ⲙ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲓⲟϯ:
text.cop_lat: + Esmou e-epshois nee-eterseveste emepshois Efnoti ente nenioti:
text.en: + Bless the Lord O you who worship the Lord the God of our fathers,
text.ar: + باركوا الرب يا عابدي الرب إله أبائنا،

text.cop: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ ϣⲁ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
text.cop_lat: hos erof arihowo chasf sha ni-eneh.
text.en: praise Him and exalt Him above all forever.

section.en: The Fourth Hoos, Ⲡⲓϩⲱⲥ ⲙ̀Ⲙⲁϩϥ̀ⲧⲟⲟⲩ

text.cop: + Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Esmou e-epshois evol khen nifeeoui alleelouia.
text.en: + Praise the Lord from the heavens Alleluia.
Praise Him all His angels Alleluia.

text.cop: + Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲡⲓⲣⲏ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲓⲟϩ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Esmou erof piree nem pioh alleelouia.
text.en: + Praise Him sun and moon Alleluia.

text.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲛⲓⲥⲓⲟⲩ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ.
text.cop_lat: Esmou erof nisiou teerou ente piowoini.
text.en: Praise Him all you stars of light.

text.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: Esmou erof nifeeoui ente nifeeoui alleelouia.
text.en: Praise Him you heavens of heavens Alleluia.
And you waters above the heavens.
text.ar: ويا أيتها المياه التي فوق السموات.

text.en: + Let them praise the name of the Lord Alleluia.
For He commanded and they were created.
He has ordered and they were created Alleluia.

text.cop: Ⲁϥⲧⲁϩⲱⲟ̀ ⲉ̀ⲣⲁⲧⲟⲩ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ ⲛⲉⲙ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
text.cop_lat: Aftaho-o eratou sha eneh nem sha eneh ente pi-eneh.
text.en: He has established them forever and ever.
text.ar: أقامها إلى الأبد وإلى أبد الأبد.

text.en: + He has made a decree which shall not pass away Alleluia.
text.ar: + وضع لها أمراً فلن تتجاوزه هلليلويا.

text.en: Praise the Lord from the earth.
You great sea creatures and all the depths Alleluia.

text.cop: Ⲟⲩⲭ̀ⲣⲱⲙ ⲟⲩⲁⲗ ⲟⲩⲭⲓⲱⲛ ⲟⲩⲭ̀ⲣⲩⲥⲧⲁⲗⲗⲟⲥ ⲟⲩⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ⲥⲁⲣⲁⲑⲏⲟⲩ ⲛⲏⲉⲧⲓ̀ⲣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉϥⲥⲁϫⲓ.
text.cop_lat: Ou-ekrom o-al oushion ou-ekhristallos ou-epnevma ensaratheeou nee-etiri empefsaji.
text.en: Fire and hail, snow and clouds, stormy wind fulfilling His word.
text.ar: النار والبرد والثلج والجليد والريح العاصفة الصانعة كلمته.

text.cop: + Ⲛⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲧϭⲟⲥⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲕⲁⲗⲁⲙⲫⲱⲟⲩ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Nitoou etchosi nem nikalamfoou teerou alleelouia.

text.cop: + Ⲛⲓⲟⲩⲣⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Niouroou ente epkahi nem nilaos teerou alleelouia.
text.en: + Kings of the earth and all people Alleluia.

text.cop: Ⲛⲓⲁⲣⲭⲱⲛ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲣⲉϥϯϩⲁⲡ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ.
text.cop_lat: Niarkhon nem nireftihap teerou ente epkahi.
text.en: Princes and all judges of the earth.
Both young men and maidens Alleluia.
+ Let them praise the name of the Lord Alleluia.
For His name alone is exalted.

text.cop: Ⲡⲉϥⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϣⲟⲡ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: Pefowonh evol shop hijen epkahi nem enehree khen etfe alleelouia.
text.en: His glory is above the earth and heaven Alleluia.
text.ar: شكره كائن على الأرض وفي السماء هلليلويا.

text.en: And He has exalted the horn of His people.

text.cop: + Ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁϥ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Ou-esmou ente nee-ethowab teerou entaf alleelouia.
text.en: + The praise of all His saints Alleluia.

text.cop: Ϫⲱ ⲙ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲃⲉⲣⲓ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: Go emepshois khen ougo emveri alleelouia.
text.en: Sing to the Lord a new song Alleluia.

text.cop: Ϫⲉ ⲁ̀ⲣⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ⲉⲕⲕⲗⲏⲥⲓⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ.
text.cop_lat: Je are pefesmou khen etekkleesia ente nee-ethowab.
text.en: And His praise in the congregation of the saints.

text.cop: + Ⲙⲁⲣⲉϥⲟⲩⲛⲟϥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲡⲓⲥⲣⲁⲏⲗ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲑⲁⲙⲓⲟϥ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Marefounof enje Pisraeel ejen fee-etafthamiof alleelouia.
text.en: + Let Israel rejoice in his Maker Alleluia.
Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

text.cop: Ⲙⲁⲣⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲡⲉϥⲣⲁⲛ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲭⲟⲣⲟⲥ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: Marou-esmou epefran ethowab khen oukhoros alleelouia.
text.en: Let them praise His name in a chorus Alleluia.

text.cop: Ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲕⲉⲙⲕⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲯⲁⲗⲧⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ ⲙⲁⲣⲟⲩⲉⲣⲯⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ.
text.cop_lat: Khen oukemkem nem oupsalteerion marowerpsalin erof.
text.en: Let them sing praises unto Him with timbrel and harp.

text.cop: + Ϫⲉ Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲛⲁϯⲙⲁϯ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲉϥⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Je Epshois natimati ejen peflaos alleelouia.
text.en: + For the Lord takes pleasure in His people Alleluia.
He will raise the meek with salvation.

text.cop: Ⲉⲩⲉ̀ϣⲟⲩϣⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: Eveshoushou emmoou enje nee-ethowab khen o-oou alleelouia.
text.en: Let the saints be joyful in glory Alleluia.
Let them sing aloud upon their beds.

text.cop: + Ⲛⲓϭⲓⲥⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲉⲧⲭⲏ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲟⲩϣ̀ⲃⲱⲃⲓ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Nichisi ente Efnoti etkee khen tou-eshvovi alleelouia.
text.en: + Let the high praises of God be in their mouth Alleluia.
And a two edged sword in their hands.
To execute vengeance on the nations Alleluia.
+ To bind their kings with chains Alleluia.

text.cop: Ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲏⲉⲧⲧⲁⲓⲏⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲱⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲡⲉⲇⲏⲥ ⲛ̀ϫⲓϫ ⲙ̀ⲃⲉⲛⲓⲡⲓ.
text.cop_lat: Nem nee-ettaieeout entoou khen hanpethees enjig emvenipi.
text.en: And their nobles with fetters of iron.
To execute on them the written judgment Alleluia.

text.cop: Ⲡⲁⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲁϥϣⲟⲡ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁϥ.
text.cop_lat: Pai-oou fai afshop khen nee-ethowab teerou entaf.
text.en: This honor have all His saints.
text.ar: هذا المجد كائن في جميع قديسيه.

text.cop: + Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁϥ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Esmou e-efnoti khen nee-ethowab teerou entaf alleelouia.
text.en: + Praise God in all His saints Alleluia.
text.ar: + سبحوا الله في جميع قديسيه هلليلويا.

text.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲧⲁϫⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥϫⲟⲙ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: Esmou erof khen pitagro ente tefgom alleelouia.
text.en: Praise Him in the firmament of His power Alleluia.

text.cop: + Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲧⲉϥⲙⲉⲧϫⲱⲣⲓ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Esmou erof e-ehree hijen tefmetgori alleelouia.
text.en: + Praise Him for His mighty acts Alleluia.

text.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡ̀ⲁ̀ϣⲁⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲙⲉⲧⲛⲓϣϯ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: Esmou erof kata epashai ente tefmetnishti alleelouia.
text.en: Praise Him according to the multitudes of His greatness Alleluia.

text.cop: + Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲏ ⲛ̀ⲥⲁⲗⲡⲓⲅⲅⲟⲥ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Esmou erof khen ou-esmee ensalpinghos alleelouia.
text.en: + Praise Him with the sound of the trumpet Alleluia.

text.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲯⲁⲗⲧⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲕⲩⲑⲁⲣⲁ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: Esmou erof khen oupsalteerion nem oukithara alleelouia.
text.en: Praise Him with psaltery and harp Alleluia.

text.cop: + Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲉⲙⲕⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲙ ϩⲁⲛⲭⲟⲣⲟⲥ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Esmou erof khen hankemkem nem hankhoros alleelouia.
text.en: + Praise Him with timbrel and chorus Alleluia.

text.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲁⲡ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲟⲣⲅⲁⲛⲟⲛ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: Esmou erof khen hankap nem o-orghanon alleelouia.
text.en: Praise Him with strings and organs Alleluia.

text.cop: + Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲩⲙⲃⲁⲗⲟⲛ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉⲥⲉ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲏ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Esmou erof khen hankimvalon enese tou-esmee alleelouia.
text.en: + Praise Him with pleasant sounding cymbals Alleluia.

text.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲩⲙⲃⲁⲗⲟⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲟⲩⲉϣⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: Esmou erof khen hankimvalon ente o-eshleeloui alleelouia.
text.en: Praise Him upon the cymbals of joy Alleluia.

text.cop: + Ⲛⲓϥⲓ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲙⲁⲣⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲁⲛ ⲙ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Nifi niven marou-esmou teerou e-efran emepshois Pennoti alleelouia.
text.en: + Let every thing that has breath praise the name of the Lord our God Alleluia.
text.ar: + كل نسمة فلتسبح إسم الرب الهنا هلليلويا.

text.cop: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ Ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓ ⲕⲉ Ⲩ̀ⲓⲱ ⲕⲉ Ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲱ Ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: Thoksa Patri ke I-io ke Agio Epnevmati alleelouia.
text.en: Glory be to the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit Alleluia.
text.ar: المجد للآب والإبن والروح القدس هلليلويا.

text.cop: + Ⲕⲉ ⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲁⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲱⲛ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Ke nin ke a-i ke is tous e-onas ton e-onon ameen alleelouia.
text.en: + Now and forever and unto the age of all ages Amen Alleluia.
text.ar: + الآن وكل أوان وإلى دهر الدهور آمين هلليلويا.

text.cop: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ ⲥⲓ ⲟ̀ Ⲑⲉⲟⲥ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: Thoksa si o Theos eemon alleelouia.
text.en: Glory to You, O our God Alleluia.
Glory be to our God Alleluia.

section.en: The First Sunday Psali, Ϯⲯⲁⲗⲓ ⲛ̀Ϩⲟⲩⲓϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ϯⲕⲩⲣⲓⲁⲕⲏ

text.en: He came and dwelt in her,
and truly she is the joy,
+ The Son of God our God,
+ For the rest of our days,
+ Be patient O Lover of Man,

section.en: Intro of the Theotokia (Leebon), Ⲗⲟⲓⲡⲟⲛ ⲁⲛϣⲁⲛⲑⲱⲟⲩϯ

text.en: for we have hope in You.
for You have (risen/come) and saved us.
+ Glory be to the Father and the Son,

text.cop: ⲕⲉ ⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ:
text.cop_lat: ke nin ke a-i ke is tous:

text.en: the age of all ages Amen.

section.en: The Seventh Part - Shere ne Maria, Ϯⲙⲁϩϣⲁϣϥⲓ - Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲉ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ

text.en: + O who gave birth to Christ,
O my Lady the Mother of God,

text.cop_lat: O-woh akkhomkhem entigom ente efmou o Pisoteer.
text.en: Yet You destroyed the power of death O Savior.

text.cop: Ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲕⲧⲟⲩⲛⲟⲥ Ⲁ̀ⲇⲁⲙ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲕ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲕⲁⲓϥ ⲛ̀ⲣⲉⲙϩⲉ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ Ⲁ̀ⲙⲉⲛϯ.
text.cop_lat: O-woh aktounos Adam nemak o-woh akaif enremhe evol khen Amenti.
text.en: You raised Adam with You and freed him form Hades.

text.cop: + Ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲟⲩ ⲛⲓⲥⲟϫⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲛⲉϩⲡⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲣⲓⲙⲓ ⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲑⲱⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲟⲩⲉ̀ⲣⲏⲟⲩ:
text.cop_lat: + Ethve ou nisojen nem ninehpi nem nirimi tetenthot emmoou nem nowereeou:
text.en: Why did you mix fragrant oil,

text.cop: Ⲡⲉϫⲉ ⲡⲓⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲉⲧϩⲓⲉⲃⲣⲏϫ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲁⲧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲙ̀ϩⲁⲩ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓϩⲓⲟⲙⲓ ⲙ̀ϥⲁⲓⲥⲟϫⲉⲛ:
text.cop_lat: Peje piangelos ethievreeg evol khaten pi-emhav ennihiomi emfaisojen:
text.en: with each other O Disciples of the Lord?
The luminous angel at the tomb said to the women carrying the spices,

text.cop: ϫⲉ ⲁϥⲟ̀ϩⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲁⲧϥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲡⲓⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ.
text.cop_lat: je afohi eratf enje Pisoteer o-woh aftonf evol khen nee-ethmoout.
text.en: "Look and be aware that the Savior has risen from the dead." Blessed are you,
The women rushed very early to Your tomb,

text.cop: Ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲁϥⲟ̀ϩⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲁⲧϥ ϩⲓϫⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡⲓⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ:
text.cop_lat: Alla afohi eratf higoou enje piangelos efgo emmos noou:
text.en: But the angel stood before them saying,
do not weep but preach the Resurrection to the Apostles." Blessed are you,

text.cop: + Ⲛⲓϩⲓⲟⲙⲓ ⲙ̀ϥⲁⲓⲥⲟϫⲉⲛ ⲁⲩⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ⲡⲉⲕⲙ̀ϩⲁⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲥ̀ⲑⲟⲓⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ ⲱ̀ Ⲡⲓⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣ.
text.cop_lat: + Nihiomi emfaisojen avi epekemhav nem pi-estoinoufi o Pisoteer.
text.en: The women came to Your tomb, carrying fragrant oil and incense O Savior.

text.cop: Ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ:
text.cop_lat: O-woh avsotem epiangelos efgo emmos noou:
text.en: They heard the angel say to them,

text.cop: ϫⲉ ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲟⲩ ⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲕⲱϯ ⲛ̀ⲥⲁ ⲫⲏⲉⲧⲟⲛϧ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲣⲉϥⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ.
text.cop_lat: je ethve ou tetenkoti ensa fee-etonkh nem nirefmoout.
text.en: "Why do you seek the living among the dead," and He being God is risen from the tomb.

text.cop: Ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟϥ ϩⲱⲥ Ⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲙ̀ϩⲁⲩ.
text.cop_lat: O-woh enthof hos Noti aftonf evol khen pi-emhav.
text.en: Glory be to the Father, and the Son,

text.cop: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ Ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓ ⲕⲉ Ⲩ̀ⲓⲱ ⲕⲉ Ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲱ Ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ.
text.cop_lat: Thoksa Patri ke I-io ke Agio Epnevmati.

text.cop: + Ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ ⲙ̀Ⲫ̀ⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ Ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ:
text.cop_lat: + Tenowosht emefiot nem Epsheeri nem Pi-epnevma Ethowab:
text.en: We worship the Father, and the Son,

text.cop: ϫⲉ ⲭ̀ⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲭ̀ⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲭ̀ⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟⲕ Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ.
text.cop_lat: je ekowab ekowab ekowab enthok Epshois.
text.en: And we proclaim and say with the Cherubim,

text.cop: Ⲕⲉ ⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲁⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲱⲛ:
text.cop_lat: Ke nin ke a-i ke is tous e-onas ton e-onon:
text.en: "Holy, holy, holy are You O Lord." Now and forever,
and unto the age of all ages amen.
You gave birth O Virgin to the Giver of Life,

text.cop: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁ̀ⲣⲉⲛⲟϩⲉⲙ ⲛ̀Ⲁ̀ⲇⲁⲙ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
text.cop_lat: o-woh arenohem enadam evol khen efnovi.
text.en: and you saved Adam from sin.
You gave joy to Eve instead of sorrow.

text.cop: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁ̀ⲣⲉⲉⲣϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲱⲛϧ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲫ̀ⲛⲟϩⲉⲙ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡ̀ⲧⲁⲕⲟ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡ̀ϣⲓⲃϯ.
text.cop_lat: o-woh are-erehmot nan emeponkh nem efnohem evol khen eptako nem epshivti.
text.en: And gave us life and salvation from corruption and alteration.

text.cop: Ⲁ̀ⲣⲉϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲧⲁⲧⲏⲥ ⲛⲁϩⲣⲉⲛ Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ Ⲡⲉⲛⲣⲉϥⲥⲱϯ:
text.cop_lat: Areshopi nan enou-eprostatees nahren Efnoti Penrefsoti:
text.en: You became our intercessor before God our Savior,

section.en: The First Hoos
section.path: Annual Days › Psalmody › Midnight Praises (Sunday) › The English Translation of St. Antony Monastery, CL

text.cop: Ⲧⲟⲧⲉ ⲁϥϩⲱⲥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲙⲱⲩ̀ⲥⲏⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲛϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲓⲥⲣⲁⲏⲗ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲓϩⲱⲇⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϫⲟⲥ ⲉⲑⲣⲟⲩϫⲟⲥ:
text.cop_lat: Tote afhos enje Mo-isees nem nensheeri empisraeel etaihothee ente Epshois o-woh afgos ethrougos:
text.en: Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to the Lord, and spoke saying,

text.cop: ϫⲉ ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲛϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ϫⲉ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲁϥϭⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩ.
text.cop_lat: je marenhos e-epshois je khen o-oou ghar afchi-oou.
text.en: "Let us sing to the Lord for He has triumphed gloriously."
The horse and its rider He has thrown into the sea,
the Lord is my strength and song,
and He has become my salvation.
He is my God and I will glorify Him,
my father's God and I will exalt Him.
The Lord is a Man of war,

text.cop: Ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲣⲉϭⲱⲟⲩⲧⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲫⲁⲣⲁⲱ̀ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲧⲉϥϫⲟⲙ ⲧⲏⲣⲥ ⲁϥⲃⲉⲣⲃⲱⲣⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲫ̀ⲓⲟⲙ.
text.cop_lat: Niverechoouts ente Fara-o nem tefgom teers afvervorou e-efiom.
text.en: Pharaoh's chariots and his army He has cast into the sea.

text.cop: Ϩⲁⲛⲥⲱⲧⲡ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲃⲁⲧⲏⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲧⲁⲧⲏⲥ ⲁϥϫⲟⲗⲕⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛ ⲫ̀ⲓⲟⲙ ⲛ̀ϣⲁⲣⲓ.
text.cop_lat: Hansotp enanavatees enetristatees afgolkou khen efiom enshari.
text.en: His chosen captains also drowned, in the Red Sea.
they sank to the bottom like a stone.
Your right hand O Lord, has become glorious in power.
Your right hand O Lord, has dashed the enemy in pieces.
And in the greatness of Your excellence,
You have overthrown those who rose against You.

text.cop: Ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉⲕⲙ̀ⲃⲟⲛ ⲁϥⲟ̀ϩⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲁⲧϥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡⲓⲙⲱⲟⲩ:
text.cop_lat: Evol hiten pi-epnevma ente pekemvon afohi eratf enje pimoou:
text.en: And with the blast of Your nostrils the waters were gathered together,
the flood stood upright like a heap,

text.cop: ⲁⲩϭⲱⲥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲓϫⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲑ̀ⲙⲏϯ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲓⲟⲙ.
text.cop_lat: avchos enje nigol khen ethmeeti emefiom.
text.en: and the depths congealed in the heart of the sea.
my desire shall be satisfied on them,

text.cop: ⲛ̀ⲧⲁϧⲱⲧⲉⲃ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲁⲥⲏϥⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲁϫⲓϫ ⲉⲣϭⲟⲓⲥ.
text.cop_lat: entakhoteb khen taseefi ente tajig ershois.
text.en: I will draw my sword, and my hand shall destroy them."

text.cop: ⲁⲩⲱⲙⲥ ⲉ̀ⲡⲉⲥⲏⲧ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲧⲁⲧϩ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲩⲟϣ.
text.cop_lat: avoms epeseet emefreeti enoutath khen hanmoou evosh.
text.en: they sank like lead in the mighty waters.

text.cop: + Ⲛⲓⲙ ⲉⲧⲟ̀ⲛⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲕ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲛⲟⲩϯ Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ.
text.cop_lat: + Nim etoni emmok khen ninoti Epshois.
text.en: Who is like You O Lord, among the gods.

text.cop: Ⲁⲕⲥⲟⲩⲧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲕⲟⲩⲓ̀ⲛⲁⲙ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲁϥⲟⲙⲕⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ.
text.cop_lat: Aksouten tekouinam evol afomkou enje epkahi.
text.en: You stretched out Your right hand, the earth swallowed them.
have led forth the people whom You have redeemed.
You have guided them in Your strength,
The people will hear and be afraid,
sorrow will take hold of the inhabitants of Palestine.

text.cop: Ⲧⲟⲧⲉ ⲁⲩⲓⲏⲥ ⲙ̀ⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲓϩⲏⲅⲉⲙⲱⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲉ̀ⲇⲱⲙ:
text.cop_lat: Tote aviees emmoou enje niheegemon ente Ethom:
text.en: Then the chiefs of Edom will be dismayed,

text.cop: ⲛⲓⲁⲣⲭⲱⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲛⲓⲙⲱⲁ̀ⲃⲓⲧⲏⲥ ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲑⲉⲣⲧⲉⲣ ⲡⲉ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥϭⲓⲧⲟⲩ.
text.cop_lat: niarkhon ente Nimo-avitees ou-esterter pe etafchitou.
text.en: the mighty men of Moab trembling, will take hold of them.

text.cop: + Ⲁⲩⲃⲱⲗ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲉⲧϣⲟⲡ ϧⲉⲛ Ⲭⲁⲛⲁⲁⲛ:
text.cop_lat: + Avvol evol enje o-on niven etshop khen Khana-an:
text.en: All the inhabitants of Canaan will melt away,

text.cop: ⲁϥⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲑⲉⲣⲧⲉⲣ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩϩⲟϯ.
text.cop_lat: afi e-ehree egoou enje ou-esterter nem ouhoti.
text.en: fear and dread will fall on them.
By the greatness of Your arm, they will be as still as a stone,
till Your people pass over O Lord,

text.cop: + Ⲁ̀ⲛⲓⲧⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲧⲟϫⲟⲩ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉⲕⲕ̀ⲗⲏⲣⲟⲛⲟⲙⲓⲁ:
text.cop_lat: + Anitou ekhoun togou hijen outoou ente tekekleeronomia:
text.en: You will bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of Your inheritance,
which You have made for Your own dwelling.

text.cop: Ⲡⲉⲕⲙⲁ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲩⲥⲉⲃⲧⲱⲧϥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲉⲕϫⲓϫ:
text.cop_lat: Pekma ethowab Epshois fee-etavsevtotf enje nekjig:
text.en: Your sanctuary O Lord, which Your hands have established,

text.cop: Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲉⲕⲟⲓ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲓⲥϫⲉⲛ ⲡ̀ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉ̀ⲧⲓ.
text.cop_lat: Epshois ekoi enouro sha eneh nem isjen epeneh o-woh eti.
text.en: the Lord shall reign forever and ever.

text.cop: + Ϫⲉ ⲁⲩⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀ⲫ̀ⲓⲟⲙ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲓϩ̀ⲑⲱⲣ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲫⲁⲣⲁⲱ̀:
text.cop_lat: + Je avi ekhoun e-efiom enje ni-ehthor ente Fara-o:

text.en: went with his chariots and his horsemen into the sea.

text.cop: Ⲁ̀ Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲫ̀ⲓⲟⲙ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲟⲩ:
text.cop_lat: A Epshois en pimoou ente efiom e-ehree egoou:
text.en: And the Lord brought back the waters of the sea on them,

text.cop: ⲛⲉⲛϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲇⲉ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲓⲥⲣⲁⲏⲗ ⲛⲁⲩⲙⲟϣⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲧϣⲟⲩⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛ ⲑ̀ⲙⲏϯ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲓⲟⲙ.
text.cop_lat: nensheeri the empisraeel navmoshi khen petshowoou khen ethmeeti emefiom.
text.en: but the children of Israel went on dry land, in the midst of the sea.

text.cop: + Ⲁⲥϭⲓ ⲇⲉ ⲛⲁⲥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁⲙ ϯⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲏⲥ ⲧ̀ⲥⲱⲛⲓ ⲛ̀Ⲁ̀ⲁ̀ⲣⲱⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲕⲉⲙⲕⲉⲙ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲥϫⲓϫ:
text.cop_lat: + Aschi the nas enje Mariam ti-eprofeetees etsoni ena-aron empikemkem khen nesjig:
text.en: Then Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took the timbrel in her hand,

text.cop: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲥⲁⲙⲉⲛϩⲏⲥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲓϩⲓⲟⲙⲓ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲉⲙⲕⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲙ ϩⲁⲛϩⲱⲥ.
text.cop_lat: o-woh avi evol samenhees enje nihiomi teerou khen hankemkem nem hanhos.
text.en: and all the women went out after her, with timbrels and with praises.

text.cop: Ⲁⲥⲉⲣϩⲏⲧⲥ ⲇⲉ ϧⲁϫⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁⲙ ⲉⲥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ:
text.cop_lat: Aserheets the khagoou enje Mariam esgo emmos:

text.en: The horse and its rider He has

section.en: The First Hoos Lobsh
section.path: Annual Days › Psalmody › Midnight Praises (Sunday) › The English Translation of St. Antony Monastery, CL

text.en: the waters of the sea split,
was shone upon by the sun,
And in front of them was,
saying "Let us sing to the Lord,
of the Mother of God Saint Mary,
for You have (risen) and saved us.

section.en: The Second Hoos
section.path: Annual Days › Psalmody › Midnight Praises (Sunday) › The English Translation of St. Antony Monastery, CL

text.cop: + Ⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲙ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲭ̀ⲣⲏⲥⲧⲟⲥ ⲟⲩⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ ⲡⲉ:
text.cop_lat: + O-onh evol emepshois je ou-ekhreestos o-aghathos pe:
text.en: O give thanks to the Lord for He is good,

text.cop: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
text.cop_lat: alleelouia je pefnai shop sha eneh.

text.en: O give thanks to the God of gods,

text.cop: ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.

text.en: For He has made the heavens,
He caused the rain to fall,
upon the face of the earth,
and gave it to His people,
the Mother of God Saint Mary,
of the whole chorus of angels,
for You have (risen) and saved us.

section.en: The Fourth Hoos
section.path: Annual Days › Psalmody › Midnight Praises (Sunday) › The English Translation of St. Antony Monastery, CL

text.cop: + Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Esmou e-epshois evol khen nifeeoui alleelouia.
text.en: Praise the Lord from the heavens alleluia.
Praise Him, all His angels alleluia.

text.cop: + Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲡⲓⲣⲏ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲓⲟϩ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Esmou erof piree nem pioh alleelouia.
text.en: Praise Him, sun and moon alleluia.

text.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲛⲓⲥⲓⲟⲩ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ.
text.cop_lat: Esmou erof nisiou teerou ente piowoini.
text.en: Praise Him all you stars of light.

text.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: Esmou erof nifeeoui ente nifeeoui alleelouia.
text.en: Praise Him you heavens of heavens alleluia.
And you waters above the heavens.
Let them praise the name of the Lord alleluia.
For He commanded and they were created.
He has ordered and they were created alleluia.

text.cop: Ⲁϥⲧⲁϩⲱⲟ̀ ⲉ̀ⲣⲁⲧⲟⲩ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ ⲛⲉⲙ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
text.cop_lat: Aftaho-o eratou sha eneh nem sha eneh ente pi-eneh.
text.en: He has established them forever and ever.
He has made a decree which shall not pass away alleluia.
Praise the Lord from the earth.
You great sea creatures and all the depths alleluia.

text.cop: Ⲟⲩⲭ̀ⲣⲱⲙ ⲟⲩⲁⲗ ⲟⲩⲭⲓⲱⲛ ⲟⲩⲭ̀ⲣⲩⲥⲧⲁⲗⲗⲟⲥ ⲟⲩⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ⲥⲁⲣⲁⲑⲏⲟⲩ ⲛⲏⲉⲧⲓ̀ⲣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉϥⲥⲁϫⲓ.
text.cop_lat: Ou-ekrom o-al oushion ou-ekhristallos ou-epnevma ensaratheeou nee-etiri empefsaji.
text.en: Fire and hail, snow and clouds, and stormy wind, fulfilling His word.

text.cop: + Ⲛⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲧϭⲟⲥⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲕⲁⲗⲁⲙⲫⲱⲟⲩ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Nitoou etchosi nem nikalamfoou teerou alleelouia.

text.cop: + Ⲛⲓⲟⲩⲣⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Niouroou ente epkahi nem nilaos teerou alleelouia.
text.en: Kings of the earth and all people alleluia.

text.cop: Ⲛⲓⲁⲣⲭⲱⲛ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲣⲉϥϯϩⲁⲡ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ.
text.cop_lat: Niarkhon nem nireftihap teerou ente epkahi.
text.en: Princes and all judges of the earth.
Both young men and maidens alleluia.
Let them praise the name of the Lord alleluia.
For His name alone is exalted.

text.cop: Ⲡⲉϥⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϣⲟⲡ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: Pefowonh evol shop hijen epkahi nem enehree khen etfe alleelouia.
text.en: His glory is above the earth and heaven alleluia.
And He has exalted the horn of His people.

text.cop: + Ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁϥ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Ou-esmou ente nee-ethowab teerou entaf alleelouia.
text.en: The praise of all His saints alleluia.

text.cop: Ϫⲱ ⲙ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲃⲉⲣⲓ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: Go emepshois khen ougo emveri alleelouia.
text.en: Alleluia Sing to Lord a new song alleluia.

text.cop: Ϫⲉ ⲁ̀ⲣⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ⲉⲕⲕⲗⲏⲥⲓⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ.
text.cop_lat: Je are pefesmou khen etekkleesia ente nee-ethowab.
text.en: And His praise in the congregation of the saints.

text.cop: + Ⲙⲁⲣⲉϥⲟⲩⲛⲟϥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲡⲓⲥⲣⲁⲏⲗ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲑⲁⲙⲓⲟϥ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Marefounof enje Pisraeel ejen fee-etafthamiof alleelouia.
text.en: Let Israel rejoice in their Maker alleluia.
Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

text.cop: Ⲙⲁⲣⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲡⲉϥⲣⲁⲛ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲭⲟⲣⲟⲥ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: Marou-esmou epefran ethowab khen oukhoros alleelouia.
text.en: Let them praise His name in the chorus alleluia.

text.cop: Ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲕⲉⲙⲕⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲯⲁⲗⲧⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ ⲙⲁⲣⲟⲩⲉⲣⲯⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ.
text.cop_lat: Khen oukemkem nem oupsalteerion marowerpsalin erof.
text.en: Let them sing praises unto Him with timbrel and harp.

text.cop: + Ϫⲉ Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲛⲁϯⲙⲁϯ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲉϥⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Je Epshois natimati ejen peflaos alleelouia.
text.en: For the Lord takes pleasure in His people alleluia.
He will raise the meek with salvation.

text.cop: Ⲉⲩⲉ̀ϣⲟⲩϣⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: Eveshoushou emmoou enje nee-ethowab khen o-oou alleelouia.
text.en: Let the saints be joyful in glory alleluia.
Let them sing aloud on their beds.

text.cop: + Ⲛⲓϭⲓⲥⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲉⲧⲭⲏ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲟⲩϣ̀ⲃⲱⲃⲓ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Nichisi ente Efnoti etkee khen tou-eshvovi alleelouia.
text.en: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth alleluia.
And a two edged sword in their hand.
To execute vengeance on the nations alleluia.
To bind their kings with chains alleluia.

text.cop: Ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲏⲉⲧⲧⲁⲓⲏⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲱⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲡⲉⲇⲏⲥ ⲛ̀ϫⲓϫ ⲙ̀ⲃⲉⲛⲓⲡⲓ.
text.cop_lat: Nem nee-ettaieeout entoou khen hanpethees enjig emvenipi.
text.en: And their nobles with fetters of iron.
To execute on them the written judgment alleluia.

text.cop: Ⲡⲁⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲁϥϣⲟⲡ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁϥ.
text.cop_lat: Pai-oou fai afshop khen nee-ethowab teerou entaf.
text.en: This honor have all His saints.

text.cop: + Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁϥ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Esmou e-efnoti khen nee-ethowab teerou entaf alleelouia.
text.en: Alleluia. Praise God, in all His saints alleluia.

text.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲧⲁϫⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥϫⲟⲙ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: Esmou erof khen pitagro ente tefgom alleelouia.
text.en: Praise Him, in the firmament of His power alleluia.

text.cop: + Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲧⲉϥⲙⲉⲧϫⲱⲣⲓ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Esmou erof e-ehree hijen tefmetgori alleelouia.
text.en: Praise Him, for His mighty acts alleluia.

text.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡ̀ⲁ̀ϣⲁⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲙⲉⲧⲛⲓϣϯ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: Esmou erof kata epashai ente tefmetnishti alleelouia.
text.en: Praise Him, according to His excellent greatness alleluia.

text.cop: + Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲏ ⲛ̀ⲥⲁⲗⲡⲓⲅⲅⲟⲥ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Esmou erof khen ou-esmee ensalpinghos alleelouia.
text.en: Praise Him, with the sound of the trumpet alleluia.

text.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲯⲁⲗⲧⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲕⲩⲑⲁⲣⲁ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: Esmou erof khen oupsalteerion nem oukithara alleelouia.
text.en: Praise Him, with the psaltery and harp alleluia.

text.cop: + Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲉⲙⲕⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲙ ϩⲁⲛⲭⲟⲣⲟⲥ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Esmou erof khen hankemkem nem hankhoros alleelouia.
text.en: Praise Him, with the timbrel and chorus alleluia.

text.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲁⲡ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲟⲣⲅⲁⲛⲟⲛ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: Esmou erof khen hankap nem o-orghanon alleelouia.
text.en: Praise Him, with stringed instruments and organs alleluia.

text.cop: + Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲩⲙⲃⲁⲗⲟⲛ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉⲥⲉ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲏ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Esmou erof khen hankimvalon enese tou-esmee alleelouia.
text.en: Praise Him, with pleasant sounding cymbals alleluia.

text.cop: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲩⲙⲃⲁⲗⲟⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲟⲩⲉϣⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: Esmou erof khen hankimvalon ente o-eshleeloui alleelouia.
text.en: Praise Him, with cymbals of joy alleluia.

text.cop: + Ⲛⲓϥⲓ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲙⲁⲣⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲁⲛ ⲙ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Nifi niven marou-esmou teerou e-efran emepshois Pennoti alleelouia.
text.en: Let everything that has breath praise the name of the Lord our God alleluia.

text.cop: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ Ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓ ⲕⲉ Ⲩ̀ⲓⲱ ⲕⲉ Ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲱ Ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: Thoksa Patri ke I-io ke Agio Epnevmati alleelouia.
text.en: Glory be to the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit alleluia.

text.cop: + Ⲕⲉ ⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲁⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲱⲛ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: + Ke nin ke a-i ke is tous e-onas ton e-onon ameen alleelouia.
text.en: Now and forever and unto the age of all ages amen alleluia.

text.cop: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ ⲥⲓ ⲟ̀ Ⲑⲉⲟⲥ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ ⲁⲗⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: Thoksa si o Theos eemon alleelouia.
text.en: Glory be to our God alleluia.
Glory be to our God alleluia.

section.en: Sunday Psali for St. Mary
section.path: Annual Days › Psalmody › Midnight Praises (Sunday) › The English Translation of St. Antony Monastery, CL

text.en: He came and dwelt in her,
and truly she is the joy,
The Son of God our God,
For the rest of our days,
Be patient O Lover of Man,

section.en: Sunday Psali for Jesus Christ
section.path: Annual Days › Psalmody › Midnight Praises (Sunday) › The English Translation of St. Antony Monastery, CL

text.en: from the depth of my heart,
so that You may save me,
with the shadow of Your wings,
In six days You have made,
